caption: Morning sun shines through red curtains, and the white bedroom walls take on a red tint.

sa.check: The bedroom walls take on a red tint.

pc.expect: The wall looks red only where the curtain's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The wall is red with the curtain off; or stays white under the red light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the curtain and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The wall changes before the curtain; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: The tint follows the shape of the light through the curtain.
pc.fail: The tint is a hard-edged square unlike the window; or covers walls the window cannot light; or splits.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The wall moves; or the curtain moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second curtain appears; or the wall vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The wall's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The wall changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the curtain changes shape.
